d:
Todd Hoffman sets his sights on an ambitious new target: a massive 5,000-ounce season goal on Gold Rush
Inspired by the legendary nuggets of High Bar, Todd gambles everything on a miracle cut. But reality hits hard when the first week's cleanup delivers a crushing blow just 38 ounces of gold, barely 15% of the weekly target needed to stay on track. With morale slipping and the operation on the line, can the crew turn things around, or will High Bar break the Hoffman team?
Watch Gold Rush Season 7, Episode 2 on Discovery Channel India.
